$comment: DDP packets worked out by hand from the 3waylabs DDP specification (http://www.3waylabs.com/ddp/), not by running the plugin. Header, 10 bytes: byte 0 flags VV x T S R Q P (VV=01 version 1 -> 0x40; P push = 0x01, set on the last packet of a frame), byte 1 sequence number in the low 4 bits (1..15, 0 = unused), byte 2 data type C R TTT SSS (C=0 standard, TTT=001 RGB, SSS=011 8 bits per element -> 0b00001011 = 0x0B), byte 3 destination id (0x01 default output device), bytes 4-7 data offset in bytes (big-endian), bytes 8-9 data length (big-endian), then the data. UDP port 4048. 1440 data bytes per packet at most (480 RGB pixels).

two_leds_rgb.$comment: LED 0 #FF0000, LED 1 #00FF00, colour order RGB, first frame (sequence 1). Single packet, so it carries push: 0x40|0x01 = 0x41. Offset 0, length 6.

two_leds_grb.$comment: same colours with colour order GRB: each LED is sent G, R, B -> red = 00 FF 00, green = FF 00 00.

five_hundred_leds.$comment: 500 LEDs all #123456 = 1500 data bytes: packet 1 carries bytes 0..1439 (length 1440 = 0x05A0) without push (0x40), sequence 1; packet 2 carries bytes 1440..1499 (offset 1440 = 0x000005A0, length 60 = 0x003C) with push (0x41), sequence 2.

sequence_wrap.$comment: single-packet frames number 1, 2, ..., 15, then 1 again (0 means 'sequence not used' and is skipped).
